content: {"praised":["Engaging historical drama set in 1492 Rome.","Strong performances, especially Jeremy Irons as Rodrigo Borgia.","Intriguing political intrigue and family dynamics.","Well-crafted period setting and visuals.","Captivating storytelling and pacing."],"criticized":["Script is amateurish and lacks tension.","Story feels boring and predictable.","Historical inaccuracies and lack of depth.","Poor pacing and lack of surprises.","Characters underdeveloped."]}
